description: Dept. of Elections - Presidential Election 08.01.2015 ending of Presidential Elections Propaganda 48 hours prior to the day of Poll
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses electoral procedures and regulations for the 2015 Presidential Election in Sri Lanka. It focuses on election propaganda restrictions, media guidelines during the silent period, and campaign activities - all of which fall under electoral processes and related matters as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The notification is issued by the Commissioner of Elections, further confirming its electoral nature.
